description: Explore, adversarially test, and curate game concepts before material implementation investment.

codex.shortDescription: Explore, challenge, and curate game concepts before building.
defaultPrompts: Explore this game brief into distinct hypotheses, then return a post-exploration human-review checkpoint.
Stress-test these existing game concepts while preserving evidence provenance and unknowns.
Curate this supplied concept set for coverage, then mark review pending before material investment.

requirements: Interactive runs may request human review at investment boundaries; unattended runs must complete with review_pending instead of blocking.
The deterministic portfolio first pass requires Python 3 when structured JSON records are used.
